Egypt coach Hossam Hassan booked for gesture during Argentina match

Egypt's national football coach, Hossam Hassan, received a booking during a match against Argentina. The booking was reportedly for making a gesture, described as an 'X sign', during the game. The incident has drawn varied reactions, with some celebrating and others criticizing the coach's actions.
